title: wilckia × hybrida
intro: Wilckia × hybrida, commonly known as the "False Gardenia", is a hybrid plant species within the Gesneriaceae family. It is known for its glossy dark green leaves and fragrant white flowers. The plant is said to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress, improving sleep, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Wilckia × hybrida include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation.
